summary: APPROVED. Task 10.3 is complete: the documentation rewrite is correct and the ADR-020 clause 8 logging security review is recorded and passing. Both acceptance criteria ('SEC-5 is rewritten'; 'the logging path is security-reviewed') and the Tests criterion ('the security-review report is recorded with no open BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM') are satisfied. Remaining items are non-blocking LOW/INFORMATIONAL: the pre-existing stale docs/project-status.md v1.1 suite count (owned by Phase 13), the stale docs/planning/v1.1.md 'zero logging call sites' line (security-review SEC-10.3-2, routed to Phase 13), and the security review's noted residuals (ArrProviderError.Message producer invariant; live host sink deferred to task 14.3; pre-existing base-URL userinfo gap).
